_description: PreToolUse guard: warns before dangerous git commands execute.
_install: Merge the 'hooks.PreToolUse' array below into your .claude/settings.json

hooks.command: bash -c 'cmd=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *"git push --force"*) echo "[GUARD] WARNING: force push — overwrites shared history";; *"git reset --hard"*) echo "[GUARD] WARNING: hard reset — uncommitted work will be lost";; *"git clean -f"*) echo "[GUARD] WARNING: git clean -f — untracked files deleted permanently";; *"rm -rf"*) echo "[GUARD] WARNING: rm -rf — irreversible deletion";; esac'
